verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a payments platform, since some products in this category ship self-hostable deployments. Nothing in the evidence shows Stripe Connect can be self-hosted. Every item describes Stripe-hosted APIs, Dashboard, embedded components and webhooks, and the CLI and MCP server are client and developer tooling, not a self-hostable core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
